description: A place name resolved to Zillow's region — id, type, parent state and city, centre and the exact bounding rectangle search uses — or a region id described. Give location or regionId.

expand.description: false (default): the compact form - the headline of a record or a search row, or the answer minus photo and tour links. true: the complete response from the data API (a full record is ~17 KB). Same price either way.

location.description: A place name to resolve, as typed into Zillow.

regionId.description: A Zillow region id to describe, instead of location.

name: zillow_region
